transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I'm just having some trouble at work. I do hair, and... I don't know. It just feels like my hands are moving through glue lately. Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing color... it takes me forever now. People have started noticing I’m just slower than I used to be.
Along with this physical slowness, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... most days I just wake up with this... heavy, flat sadness in my chest. It just kind of feels like... I don't know. Like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down and slow in the past, or is this the first time?

Um... no, I don't think so. It's just been this one time. But it's been going on for a while now. Like... maybe a year and eight months? It started... I guess after they cut my hours at work. My savings were just draining away, and... yeah. Just since then.

{"intent": "Screen for physical signs of hypothyroidism such as cold intolerance to evaluate for medical etiology.", "question": "Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually sensitive to the cold, even when others are comfortable?"
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't think I've noticed anything like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I suppose. I just... I don't really feel like doing much lately. At work, I used to chat with my clients a lot... maybe help the newer stylists out. But now I just kind of keep my head down. I try to avoid people, mostly. Even outside of work... I used to go hiking with friends, but... I don't know. I just don't have that spark in me anymore.
How has your sleep been during this time?
Um... it's fine, I guess. I sleep. Just... normal, I think.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight during this time?

Um... I guess so. I haven't really been eating much. Sometimes I just... forget. Like, I'll get to the end of the day and realize I only had a coffee and maybe a bite of something small. I didn't really mean to skip meals, it just happens. And... my clothes are definitely fitting looser now.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy nearly every day?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I'm not physically exhausted or anything. My energy is fine, I guess.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing your mind, or making everyday decisions?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Sometimes at work, I'll just stare at the color formulas... or the appointment screen. And my brain just kind of... blanks. I end up second-guessing simple things I used to do automatically. But... yeah.
Have you had any thoughts of ending your life, or felt like you would be better off dead?

Um... I don't know. I mean, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... sometimes I just think it would be easier if I didn't wake up. Like... then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
